1.mascotDialogue: The pivot doesn't move again after partitioning — it's already home. Everything left to sort is strictly smaller on one side, strictly bigger on the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 places the pivot at its final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse on the strictly-smaller and strictly-larger sides — the pivot itself is never touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happened to be the smallest value, so it ends up at index 0 — an unlucky pivot choice, and a fair example of why pivot selection matters for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out — p instead of p minus 1 — and the recursion loses its most important guarantee: that every recursive call works on a strictly smaller range than the one before.
